Definition: apparently a primary verb; to pour out as a libation, i.e. (figuratively) to devote (one's life or blood, as a sacrifice) ("spend"):--(be ready to) be offered.
BiblicalUsage: Paul pictures his life as a drink offering poured out. If I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and at the end he says plainly, I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul's offering is the pattern of a life given away: poured out on the sacrifice of other people's faith, and glad of it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
